# RotatingStream

A stored borrow of a [`RotatingFile`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file) that speaks `Writer`, for a [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) to keep.

```rux
pub struct RotatingStream {
    // private fields
}
```

The address is private, and [`RotatingFile::Stream`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file#stream) is the only way to obtain one.

## Implements Writer

`RotatingStream` conforms to `Writer`.

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(
    self: &var RotatingStream,
    bytes: char8[..]
) -> uint ! IoError
```

Writes through the borrowed file, which may move its current file aside first.

| Name    | Type        | Description        |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the bytes to write |

**Returns**: how many bytes were taken

```rux
pub func Flush(self: &var RotatingStream) -> ! IoError
```
